## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes and why. Distinguish working behavior from future plans.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results and any unverified behavior.

## Data and security impact

Explain synchronization, permission, migration or recovery consequences, if applicable.

## AI development disclosure

Describe material AI assistance and the review performed. Do not imply independent review that did
not occur.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code is documented in English and formatted.
- [ ] Both root READMEs and relevant technical documents are current.
- [ ] No personal data, runtime tokens or private deployment details are included.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral tests cover meaningful failure modes.
- [ ] Dependency licenses and attribution have been checked.
